Parse_Payload_to_Object.description: Create a JSON object based on the payload provided. N.B. we're not using the Parse JSON operation as we expect more than 1 payload type.

Process_Document_Case_And_Handoff.description: Stage 1 of the split: extract payload values, resolve reference data and exporter, create/update the document and case, then publish the document/case hand-off envelope and complete the source message.

inputs.name: CatchesProductsArray
inputs.value: @if( contains(variables('Payload'), 'catches'), variables('Payload')['catches'], if( contains(variables('Payload'), 'products'), variables('Payload')['products'], null))

Set_Exporter_Object.description: Sets the Exporter object using the exporter or exporterDetails property in the Payload object

Set_CaseTypeName.description: If the root of the payload is an array, then this implies a Landing Detail payload, which is a Catch Certificate Case Type

body.statuscode: @if(contains(variables('Payload'), 'caseType2'), if(contains(variables('Payload')['caseType2'], 'Void by an Exporter'), 961040000, if(contains(variables('Payload')['caseType2'], 'Void by SMO/PMO'), 961040001, 1)), null)

@if(contains(variables('Payload'), 'caseType2'), if(contains(variables('Payload')['caseType2'], 'Void by an Exporter'), 961040000, if(contains(variables('Payload')['caseType2'], 'Void by SMO/PMO'), 961040001, 1)), outputs('Status_Reason'))

Build_Handoff_Message.description: Versioned hand-off envelope published to document-case-queue for the downstream landings/catches stage.

Publish_to_document-case-queue.description: Send the document/case hand-off envelope to the next stage. Session id is the document number so per-document ordering is preserved downstream.

Complete_the_message_in_a_queue.description: Settle the source message only after the hand-off has been published successfully.

Handle_Failure.description: Error handler. On any failure in the document/case stage or hand-off, abandon the source message so Service Bus can redeliver it (native retry, max delivery count 5; auto dead-letters afterwards).
